name: Ghost Fibers
description: WebGL2 background of twisting, wavy ribbons made of glowing dots, dashes or lines, with depth of field, bloom, floating dust, mouse focus and click pulses.
contents: Single full-size container with a WebGL2 canvas
Up to 3 ribbon layers of fiber threads, dust particles, bloom, vignette and grain post effects
behavior: Ribbons wave, twist and roll continuously over time
Pointer position over the window drives a hover effect (focus, part or none)
Clicking sends a pulse through the fibers when pulseOnClick is on
Fades in with a 2.6 second intro when intro is on
Rendering pauses when off screen or the tab is hidden, and reduced motion preference is respected
Canvas resolution is capped and scaled by device pixel ratio up to 2
editableByProps: Glow, line and secondary colors, gradient direction and light mode
Motion: speed, rotation, roll, waves, twist, flow, paused
Shape: layers, threads, volume, spread, density, thickness, scale, fiber style, tips
Look: glow, brightness, depth of field, focus depth, perspective, particles, sparkle, vignette, grain
Interaction: mouse interaction, hover effect, strength, click pulse, intro, render dpr

needsCodeEdit.change: Change ribbon length or camera distance and field of view
needsCodeEdit.where: RIBBON_LENGTH, CAMERA and FOV constants at the top of the file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change ribbon placement or relative brightness of layers
Change bloom quality or maximum render size

fixed: Container is h-full w-full, so the parent must have a height (for example a sized or absolute positioned wrapper); content must be layered above it
Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable or shaders fail to compile
Pointer and click listeners are attached to window, so interaction responds across the whole page, not only over the component
Canvas is aria-hidden and purely decorative
Extra props are spread onto the root div
Heavy GPU shader with bloom passes, can be costly on low-end mobile devices; lower threads, layers or dpr there
Needs a dark backdrop by default; set lightMode for light pages
